content.short: claimr provides a Quest Management System (QMS) and data analytics for Web3.
content.description: claimr is a no-code SaaS for launching quests, point systems, referral campaigns, and other on-chain and off-chain activities. It integrates into landing pages, mobile apps, and Telegram mini apps as a white-label solution to boost lifetime value, retention, engagement, referrals, and conversion rates, while lowering customer acquisition costs. With claimr, teams can deploy incentive programs quickly without coding, manage campaigns from a central dashboard, and measure performance in real time.
